title: Cloudflare Status - Network Performance Issues in Virginia and Ohio United States
text:
Service: Cloudflare Status
Incident: Network Performance Issues in Virginia and Ohio United States
Status: resolved
Impact: minor
Started: 2026-10-18T08:00:00.000Z
Resolved: 2026-10-18T08:50:00.000Z
Updates:
- 2026-10-18T09:37:13.177Z: resolved - Due to unexpected prefix withdrawals on peering links in IAD and CMH (Ashburn, Virginia and Columbus, Ohio, in the United States) on an external provider, customers experienced increased latency and timeouts from 08:00 to 08:50 UTC. Services have fully normalized following the restoration of prefix advertisements.
